settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
These steps are aligned with 7E Wellness’ official protocols:

  1. Cleanse the skin thoroughly before treatment (as required for all microcurrent protocols).
  2. Hydrate for conductivity: Apply a water-based serum or lightly mist with RePlenish Spritzer. (Do not use oil-based products)
  3. Apply ReStore Gel generously across face, including under the eyes, using the silicone brush.
  4. Place the Eye Mask:
  • Peel off its plastic backing.
  • Connect it to your device via lead wire.
  • Position it gently under the eye area, ensuring good contact.
  1. Run the device: Use Level 1 Erase and Level 1 Educate modes for a combined session of 10–30 minutes (split between the two) with the Eye Mask.
  2. Optional glove treatment: You may incorporate conductive gloves concurrently or after mask use to address cheeks, jawline, or eye area (gloves may not always need extra gel).
  3. Remove & clean: Take off the Eye Mask, wipe gently with an alcohol wipe, then return the mask to its backing for storage (usable for 10–15 times).
  4. Rinse or massage off excess gel into skin.
  5. Finish with Eye Lift Serum, applying around the eye area and gently tapping in.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: How many sessions are recommended to see results?
settings.text1:
Most people see some subtle results after just one treatment. With continued
treatments you will see those results build as a result of your skin health improving and your
facial muscles becoming stronger. A younger person will typically achieve their desired result
faster, sometimes in as little as 4 weeks. An older person with more progressive signs of
aging may require up to 16 weeks of treatments to meet their goals. The Myolift QT is safe
for daily use and users are recommended to perform at least 3 treatments per week for best
results.
settings.title2: Is the smart application free or paid and what does it include?
settings.text2:
When you purchase a MyoliftQT Premium, you automatically have full lifetime
access to the Myolift QT App. When you purchase a Myolift QT Base, you receive a free
30-day trial of the Myolift QT App that starts on the day you make your account in the App.
Once your 30-day Trial expires, you have the option to re-subscribe monthly, yearly, or
permanently via an in app purchase. If you choose not to re-subscribe, you will no longer
have full app access, however you can still complete your recommended treatments in the
‘My Plan’ section of your app or use your device in App Free Mode. Click here to learn more
about the QT Premium App’s exclusive features.

settings.title4: Why choose MyoLift QT over other MyoLift devices?
settings.text4:
The Myolift QT was designed with at-home skincare routines in mind. This
intuitive handheld device is the easiest and fastest device for users to learn and use. It pairs
with an instructional app which makes it effortless for anyone to enjoy True Microcurrent
treatments on the go or in the comfort of their home. The Myolift QT App acts as your
personalized skin coach by recommending customized treatments based on your unique
skin profile and walking you step-by-step through each of your treatments. The Myolift QT is
loved by beginners, busy moms, frequent travelers, workaholics, and anyone looking to
begin their microcurrent journey.
settings.title5: How does App Free Mode work?
settings.text5:
In App Free Mode, the QT will always run through 5 minutes on "Stretch" followed
by 10 minutes on "Lift." During this App Free Treatment, the ON button will be locked, but
the device will power off after 3 minutes with no conductivity. The intensity of the treatment is
preset to "Low" at 175 microAmps. You can increase it to "High" at 300 microAmps in your
App via 'App Free Mode' on the 'Sessions' Menu. Here's how App Free Mode works:
- After charging, turn on your QT Plus. The light near the ON button should be blue.
- You can attach any accessories you like via the QT's Lead Wire, or proceed with just the
QT.
- Wait for 5 Seconds. You will see the light turn green.
- Touch the device/accessory to your skin and the QT will buzz to tell you the treatment has
begun.
- The green light near the ON button will be solid when conductivity is good, and it will blink
when conductivity is lost.
-When the Waveform switches after 5 minutes from "Stretch" to "Lift," the device will buzz
once. It will buzz again when the treatment is over.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: What is “depuffing” in this context and how does this kit deliver it?
settings.text1: Depuffing means reducing fluid retention, under-eye bags, facial puffiness and promoting lymphatic drainage. This kit does that via a hands-free eye mask, conductive gloves, ReStore gel, RePlenish spritzer, and a silicone brush—they enable targeted microcurrent work around the eye area and surrounding zones.
settings.title2: How do I use this kit for the under-eye area specifically?
settings.text2: Cleanse → hydrate with spritzer → apply ReStore gel under eyes/cheeks using silicone brush → apply hands-free eye mask and connect device → run Level 1 Erase + Level 1 Educate (10-30 minutes) → optionally use conductive gloves on adjacent areas → massage leftover gel in and apply Eye Lift Serum.
settings.title3: Is this kit only for under-eyes or full-face puffiness too?
settings.text3: While it’s optimized for under-eye and lower-face puffiness, you can use the conductive gloves and gel across cheeks, jawline, or other puff-prone areas. The eye mask remains the specialized targeted piece.
settings.title4: Can this kit help with dark circles or just swelling?
settings.text4: It primarily addresses puffiness, circulation, and fluid retention. Some reduction in dark circles may follow improved circulation and microcurrent stimulation, but if your main concern is pigment or hollowing you may combine with a brightening or filler kit.
settings.title5: How many sessions should I do to see a visible reduction in puffiness?
settings.text5: You may see a visible “de-puffed” look after 2-3 sessions in the first 2 weeks if your skin responds well. For longer-term change plan 4-6 sessions (weekly) then reduce frequency to maintain.
settings.title6: Is this kit safe for those with sensitive eye skin or contact lenses?
settings.text6: Use caution around the delicate under-eye area. Remove contact lenses if the mask is near the eye and ensure the mask sits properly and comfortably. If you have very sensitive skin, do a patch test around the orbital bone (not on the eyelid). If you experience irritation lasting over 24 hours, discontinue use.
